name: @quandev104/pi-style
description: A native-layout, cohesive visual style package for Pi.

scripts.package:smoke: node --input-type=module -e "const manifest = await import('./package.json', { with: { type: 'json' } }); const entry = manifest.default.pi.extensions[0]; if (entry !== './extension-src/pi-style/pi/index.ts') throw new Error('invalid Pi extension manifest path: ' + entry); const { readFileSync } = await import('node:fs'); const source = readFileSync('./extension-src/pi-style/pi/index.ts', 'utf8'); if (!/export\s+default\s+function/.test(source)) throw new Error('extension TS entry has no default factory'); if (!source.includes('createPiStyleSessionCoordinator')) throw new Error('extension TS entry missing coordinator wiring'); console.log('package smoke: extension TS entry valid (jiti loads with Pi runtime aliases)');"""
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run depcruise && npm run test && npm run build && npm run package:smoke
